coverage.summary: Applies to units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance. These are most multifamily units built before 1980, new construction (certificate of occupancy after June 1980), single-family homes, most condominiums and units with listed government subsidies. Units exempt from the Rent Ordinance are excluded: Golden Duplexes, units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath, certain ADU properties, university housing and nonprofit cooperatives.
coverage.other_conditions: Applies only to tenancies in units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance; units exempt from the Rent Ordinance are not covered.

result.notes: Changed requires_unknown_facts to false. The rule covers ordinary rental buildings, including pre-1980 multifamily, post-1980 new construction, single-family homes and condos. Its exemptions (Golden Duplex, shared kitchen/bath, ADU, university, cooperative) cannot be checked from assessor data, so they stay in unverifiable_exemptions. No construction cutoff applies because both pre- and post-1980 units are covered. Removed the summary's reference to Civ. Code § 1950.5 because no document supports that citation.
